tags.label: Kind

options.label: Main move
options.description: The standard, recommended move here.

options.label: Alternative
options.description: An unusual but valid play: it works as well, or nearly.

options.label: Situational
options.description: Good only in some whole-board situations (ladders, nearby stones…).

options.label: Slack / passive
options.description: Too passive: it works, but gives the opponent an easy game.

options.label: Mistake
options.description: A clear error that loses points or safety.

options.label: Overplay
options.description: Too greedy or too severe: it can be punished.

options.label: Trick play
options.description: A trap that works if the opponent answers naturally, but fails against the right answer.

options.label: Punishment
options.description: The answer that punishes the previous mistake, overplay or trick.

tags.description: What kind of move this is: how good it is and how it is used.

tags.label: Intention

options.label: Aggressive
options.description: Seeks a fight or puts pressure on the opponent.

options.label: Balanced
options.description: Neither aggressive nor passive: keeps options open.

options.label: Solid
options.description: Safe and thick: avoids weaknesses, gives up a little speed.

tags.description: The spirit of the move.

tags.label: Purpose

options.label: Territory
options.description: To make or secure territory.

options.label: Influence
options.description: To build outward strength (a wall, thickness).

options.label: Sente
options.description: To finish in sente and play elsewhere.

options.label: Attack
options.description: To attack a weak group.

options.label: Defend
options.description: To make one of your own groups safe.

options.label: Sabaki
options.description: To settle a group lightly inside the opponent’s sphere.

options.label: Probe
options.description: To ask the opponent a question and see how they answer.

options.label: Reduce
options.description: To reduce the opponent’s territory or framework from outside.

options.label: Connect
options.description: To connect two groups.

options.label: Cut
options.description: To separate the opponent’s stones.

options.label: Eye
options.description: To make an eye (or eye space).

options.label: Kill
options.description: To take away eyes and kill the group.
